summary: Commerce platform for building and running online stores, with apps extending the merchant admin and storefront.
access_note: Free dev stores and custom apps via Dev Dashboard; public multi-store apps need App Store registration and review.
blocker_note: Public distribution to many stores requires Shopify App Store approval; custom distribution is limited to a single store.

evidence.quote: You don't implement OAuth by hand for most apps.
Dev stores: You own them, for building and testing without touching a live store.
Public distribution also requires registering for the Shopify App Store, which has a one-time fee.
The Admin API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance the Shopify admin.
connect to Shopify's developer resources through the Dev MCP server

notes: The Dev MCP server is a local docs/dev-tooling server, not a store-operations server; store-level MCP not verified. Token header and REST legacy status not verified by direct quote. Fetch tool paraphrased some page text.
